Licence: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE in this folder; SPDX headers in every file)
Taken: src/hololink/emulation (the HSB Emulator: device-side BOOTP, ECB, RoCE v2 / CoE data planes, Linux and STM32 targets)
       and the two header-only core files it includes (src/hololink/core/serializer.hpp, deserializer.hpp).
Dropped: examples/*.cu (CUDA utilities, not buildable here).
Unmodified. Our build files, stub and programs are in tda4/hsb/ (docs/repo-layout.md: upstream code stays unmodified in third-party/).
Retrieved 2026-10-10 by git clone --depth 1.

Review note (2026-10-10): a commit security scan flagged unvalidated lengths in the STM32 target (src/STM32/spi.cpp and
siblings). That target is NVIDIA's microcontroller port; it is not built or run here (only src/common and src/linux are
compiled, on the TDA4VM, on a private bench network). Upstream code is left as is; report upstream if it matters to a reader.

Second review note (2026-10-10): the same scan flagged src/common/hsb_emulator.cpp, which we do build: the ECB control-plane
handler takes the address count from the UDP length field without checking it against the received buffer. Upstream
behaviour, unmodified here. Treat the emulator as a bench tool on a private link between the board and one host, never on
a shared or untrusted network. Worth reporting upstream; a fix would be a patch file in tda4/hsb, not an edit here.
